summary: Implement installable Android Portable POS with existing POS UI, durable/offline tickets and shared Windows/iOS/Android receipt setup and printing; no deployment

validation.name: Scoped Android durable POS and cross-platform receipt implementation

nativeRequirements.android: Separate local POS QA install; production identity/signing/store activation deferred
nativeRequirements.ios: Assess any receipt bridge delta and verify without publication
nativeRequirements.windows: Reuse existing Portable host and shared receipt pipeline

authorization: User requests Android Portable POS, shared existing POS UI, durable/offline tickets, receipt printing, and common receipt setup for iOS/Windows/Android. Thorough local/QA checks only; no deployment.
safetyScope: Preserve POS ID/capabilities, signed offline lease/localCommands, single-writer ownership, immutable receipt/payment authority, drafts, and existing apps. Do not add direct Bluetooth/USB sensitive permissions or register a store identity without a concrete separately authorized decision. System printing/PDF first.
